name: Power Plants & Energy Conversion
summary: Large-scale conversion of fuel and natural energy into electricity and heat: steam, gas-turbine, combined-cycle, cogeneration, nuclear and hydro plants.

topics.name: Energy resources, demand and the power generation mix
Steam power plants: layout and Rankine-cycle performance
Boilers and steam generators: heat rate and efficiency
Condensers, feedwater heaters and cooling systems (cooling towers)
Combined-cycle plants and heat recovery steam generators
Cogeneration and combined heat and power (CHP)
Plant economics: levelised cost of electricity and load curves
